summary.text: Salman Bhojani is a Democratic state representative from Texas House District 92 who has served since January 10, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Republican JP Woodruff is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Salman Bhojani was born in Pakistan and lives in Euless, Texas.

He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas at Dallas in 2003 and a law degree from Southern Methodist University in 2013, and his career experience includes working as an attorney and business owner.
He served on the Euless City Council.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Bhojani said he was elected to the council in 2018 as the first person of color to hold elected office in Euless and later served as mayor pro tem.
Bhojani assumed office in the Texas House on January 10, 2023, succeeding Jeff Cason.
In the 2026 survey, he said he is vice chair of the Delivery of Government Efficiency Committee and a member of the Trade, Workforce, and Economic Development Committee.
He listed his policy interests as education, religious freedom, small business and economic development, property tax, and AI and technology.
